concepts.narration: 那是手腕的油脂日積月累壓進纖維裡,不是表面的髒。整件下水才會勻,只搓袖口反而會留下一圈更深的印子。
concepts.close: 羽絨外套 280 起,台中免費到府收送。
concepts.before_subject: a navy down jacket sleeve cuff, the ribbed band darkened grey-black with ingrained skin oil, fabric intact
concepts.after_subject: the same cuff clean and evenly navy again, the rib texture visible, no bleaching and no new fluff

concepts.narration: 掛了一整季沒穿,灰會沿著肩膀那條線慢慢積起來。刷不掉是因為它早就卡進毛裡,要整件洗才拉得出來。
concepts.close: 長大衣 300 起,收前先拍一張給我看。
concepts.before_subject: a charcoal wool coat shoulder line with a pale dust band settled along the seam, weave intact
concepts.after_subject: the same shoulder clean and evenly charcoal, the twill weave crisp, shape unchanged

concepts.narration: 絨毛倒了就會發硬發亮是不是髒？洗完得把整片絨面重新刷順才回得來,用濕布擦只會把它壓得更平。
concepts.close: 麂皮鞋 400 起,不確定材質先拍給我。
concepts.before_subject: a tan suede shoe whose nap has flattened and gone shiny across the vamp, no tears
concepts.after_subject: the same shoe with the nap lifted and even again, matte and soft-looking, colour unchanged

concepts.narration: 包在外面的那層皮磨穿了,底下的材質才會露出來。清潔救不回這一塊,鞋面能洗,跟頭得換一片新的皮上去。
concepts.close: 高跟鞋 400 起,補跟另計,先拍給我看。
concepts.before_subject: a black leather high heel with the heel tip covering worn through to pale base material
concepts.after_subject: the same shoe cleaned, upper leather even and matt, the worn heel tip still visibly worn

concepts.narration: 老是扣同一格那一摺塗層會不會先斷開？清完顏色會淡一點,但斷掉的那條線還是要補色才會平回去。
concepts.before_subject: a brown leather belt with a pale cracked crease at the habitual buckle hole, leather whole
concepts.after_subject: the same belt cleaned and conditioned, colour even, the crease still faintly visible

concepts.narration: 汗滲過去再乾掉是不是留下一圈邊？它幫你擋的是整張床墊,所以換季的時候該跟被子一起洗過一次。
concepts.close: 保潔墊 120,台中免費到府收送。
concepts.before_subject: a white quilted mattress pad with a faint yellow ring where sweat has soaked and dried
concepts.after_subject: the same pad clean and evenly white, quilting intact, no bleach patches

concepts.narration: 球是摩擦磨出來的是不是被洗壞了？修掉之後手感就會回來,但下次要單獨洗,才不會再被拉鍊磨到。
concepts.before_subject: a grey fleece blanket surface covered in small pills, fabric otherwise whole
concepts.after_subject: the same blanket with pills removed, surface flat and soft, colour unchanged

concepts.narration: 布被撐開之後就回不去了,洗過也只會縮回一部分而已。想留住版型,別等到整片都發白了才送過來。
concepts.before_subject: a pair of indigo jeans with stretched pale knees holding a permanent bend, no holes
concepts.after_subject: the same jeans washed and pressed, knees flatter and colour more even, honest wear still there

concepts.narration: 邊油磨掉之後,裡層纖維才會翹起來,那是最早的警訊。這時候補只要薄薄一層,再拖就得整條重上。
concepts.close: 長皮夾 600 起,補色另計。
concepts.before_subject: a brown leather long wallet with the edge coating worn thin and fibres lifting at one corner
concepts.after_subject: the same wallet cleaned, leather even, the thinned edge still visible but no loose fibres

concepts.narration: 小孩踢地板磨出來的,只要面料還在就一定洗得回來。與其急著買新的一雙,先看那層膠有沒有裂開。
concepts.before_subject: a small white children's sneaker with the rubber toe cap scuffed grey, upper intact
concepts.after_subject: the same shoe clean, toe cap white again with honest fine scratches remaining

concepts.narration: 泥乾掉之後會把鞋底的溝整個填平,抓地力就跟著沒了。硬刷會傷到防水層,要先泡開再慢慢帶出來。
concepts.before_subject: a brown hiking boot with dried mud packed into the lug pattern of the sole
concepts.after_subject: the same boot with the lugs clear and defined again, leather uppers clean and not over-wetted

concepts.narration: 汗和止汗劑會起反應變成黃斑,放得越久就越難退。當季就洗掉最好處理,收進櫃子放一季就定型了。
concepts.before_subject: a cream knit sweater with a yellowed patch under the arm, knit structure intact
concepts.after_subject: the same sweater clean and evenly cream, knit unchanged, no stretching

concepts.narration: 梅雨櫃子放一季皮面是不是長這層白灰？霉根會吃進皮革,越晚處理越難救,先拍照傳給我們看狀況。
concepts.close: 發霉別急著丟,LINE 傳照片,台中免費收送。
concepts.before_subject: a pair of black leather lace-up boots covered in a dry white-grey bloom of mould across toe and shaft, yellow welt stitching, unbranded
concepts.after_subject: the same boots wiped back to deep glossy black, welt stitch clean, no mould, honest creases still visible

concepts.narration: 膠邊的黃是氧化,刷不掉;布面的黃是洗劑殘留,洗得回來。兩種黃的做法不一樣,拍照傳來就知道。
concepts.close: 運動鞋 250 起,台中免費收送。
concepts.before_subject: one pair of unbranded white sneakers, midsole foxing oxidised to uneven amber darkest near the ground, grey abrasion bands across the toe-box canvas
concepts.after_subject: the same sneakers with the foxing returned to even off-white, canvas clean, laces brighter but not new
